posts.title: The Governor of the Great State of Maryland, Wes Moore, has put a halt to all work being done at Joint Base Andrews Air Force Base, concerning the renovation and restoration of their two old and dilapidated Golf Courses, into two, World Class, Jack Nicklaus Designed Courses, plus nine additional holes, also designed by Jack, specially adapted for our Wounded Warriors. By doing this, the Governor is attacking the United States Air Force, and our Military, not a smart thing to do. These Courses exist, they are terrible, Jack Nicklaus will make them GREAT. Why should the Air Force and other Military personnel be forced to wait through a long Legal Review process and, perhaps, even more so, why should Wounded Warriors be forced to travel long distances to play Golf somewhere else or, worse yet, not play Golf at all. Our Soldiers and Veterans deserve THE BEST — NO WAITING, NO GAMES! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.title: I am pleased to announce the nomination of Stuart Nash to the District of Columbia Court of Appeals! Stuart is currently a Partner at Holland & Knight LLP, and previously served as a Judge on the D.C. Superior Court. He also worked as a Senior Official in the Office of the Deputy Attorney General, and was a TOUGH ON CRIME Prosecutor in the D.C. U.S. Attorney’s Office. Stuart will help us continue to make our Nation’s Capital SAFE AND BEAUTIFUL AGAIN. Congratulations Stuart! President DONALD J. TRUMP

Superior Court, and previously served as a Senior DOJ Official, and Chief of the Criminal Division in the Maryland U.S. Attorney’s Office. He is also a longtime Army Reservist.
